_ids.py:253 `if not quiet:` guarding "Error: Ambiguous alias '{ticket_id}' matches multiple tickets: ..."
_ids.py:275 `if not quiet:` guarding "Error: Ambiguous prefix '{ticket_id}' matches multiple tickets: ..." — the only branch a test hits
test file uses only `AMBIG_PREFIX = "2f3c"` (test_transition_close.py:28); control asserts `"Ambiguous prefix" in capsys.readouterr().err` (test_transition_close.py:82) — prefix branch only

ABSENCE: repo-wide search of tests/ for 'Ambiguous 8-hex' and 'Ambiguous alias' returns no matches; existing resolve_ticket_id tests (test_ticket_alias_backfill.py, test_path_injection_guards.py) cover valid forms / traversal / alias / Jira / 'cannot list', none assert ambiguity-suppression on the 8-hex or alias paths
RCA in ticket af11-ac5f-4e86-4d1d names all three sites (:229-233 8-hex, :249-254 alias, :270-274 prefix) as the behavior changed by quiet
advisory.finding: The quiet=True gating is added at three diagnostic sites in resolve_ticket_id (8-hex ambiguity, _ids.py:233; alias ambiguity, _ids.py:253; prefix ambiguity, _ids.py:275) but the new tests exercise only the prefix branch. AMBIG_PREFIX='2f3c' is a 4-char, dash-less string that (per _SHORT_ID_RE=^[a-z0-9]{4}-[a-z0-9]{4}$) skips the 8-hex branch and lands in the len>=4 prefix branch — confirmed by the control test asserting the exact 'Ambiguous prefix' string. No test in the diff or the wider suite triggers the 8-hex or alias quiet gate, so reverting `if not quiet:` on either of those two branches would leave every test passing: a regression there is undetectable.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add two direct resolve_ticket_id unit tests: (1) a tracker with two tickets sharing an 8-hex short prefix (e.g. `abcd-1234-...` x2), assert resolve_ticket_id('abcd-1234', tracker, quiet=True) is None with no 'Ambiguous 8-hex' on stderr, and without quiet emits it; (2) a tracker with two tickets resolving to the same alias, assert quiet=True suppresses 'Ambiguous alias' while the default emits it.
